name: Rubber Legs
concept: A deliberate contrast between chaos and composure: legs behave like rubber — buckling, rebounding, wobbling — while the upper body stays deadpan and businesslike. Immediately funny and robust to imperfect motion transfer.
hook: Knees give out instantly — and your upper body refuses to notice.
firstSecond: Both knees buckle inward at once and the body drops ~20cm — while hands stay casually in pockets and the face stays deadpan — then springs back up.

sequence.name: Buckle
sequence.description: Instant inward knee buckle and drop; upper body composed. Spring back.

sequence.name: Rebound
sequence.description: Legs snap outward and the body bounces sideways to one side.

sequence.name: Noodle walk
sequence.description: Two steps with extreme knee wobble, feet flicking outward.

sequence.name: Business as usual
sequence.description: Upper body casually adjusts collar or sleeve while the legs keep wobbling.

sequence.name: Double buckle
sequence.description: Two quick buckles, then straighten sharply to attention.

signature: The Composed Collapse: a deep inward knee buckle with a perfectly still, unimpressed upper body.
loopPoint: Ends standing straight with hands in pockets — the same stance the opening buckle starts from.
cameraGuidance: Locked-off camera at hip height, full body in frame with some headroom so the vertical drop reads clearly.
motionTransferConsiderations: Designed to tolerate imperfect transfer: exaggerated leg motion hides minor limb artifacts.
Keep hands visible or clearly in pockets for the whole take — half-hidden hands confuse pose estimation.
Knee buckles should stay above ~90° to avoid self-occlusion of the legs.
generationGuidance: Motion from an owned reference performance only. Prompt reinforces the calm upper body. Character orientation from video. Reference audio off.

referenceCapture.performerBrief: One performer, hands in pockets or casually adjusting clothes, performs sudden inward knee buckles, sideways rebounds and a noodle walk. The face stays unimpressed throughout.
referenceCapture.wardrobe: Trousers that show knee movement clearly (no very baggy pants), jacket or collared shirt for the 'composed' contrast.
referenceCapture.framing: Portrait 9:16, head-to-feet in frame with headroom for the vertical drop, plain background, even lighting.
